title: PublicToilet schema
description: A room or small building containing one or more toilets, and possibly urinals, available for use by the general public or by customers of the hosting premises. Extends https://schema.org/PublicToilet. Boolean properties follow a tri-state convention: omitted means unknown, false means known to be absent.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be PublicToilet

toiletType.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Kind of installation. fixed: permanent building or room; automatic: self-cleaning automatic unit (superloo); portable: temporary or movable unit. Enum:'fixed, automatic, portable'. Source: LGA AutomaticPublicConvenience, NPTM FacilityType, OSM portable

disposal.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Waste disposal method. Enum:'flush, chemical, pitLatrine, bucket'. Source: OSM toilets:disposal

genderCategory.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. User groups the toilets are designated for. Enum:'female, male, unisex, allGender, childrenOnly'. Source: LGA Category, NPTM Male/Female/Unisex/AllGender

toiletPosition.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Toilet positions available. Enum:'seated, squat, urinal'. Source: OSM toilets:position, LGA Category 'Male urinal'

level.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Floor level where the toilets are located, 0 being ground level. Source: OSM level

accessType.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Who may use the toilets. public: anyone; customers: customers of the hosting premises only; permissive: publicly usable by permission of a private owner, not guaranteed. Enum:'public, customers, permissive'. Source: OSM access, LGA PartOfCommunityScheme

openingHours.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/openingHours'. Opening hours as schema.org/OSM-style strings, e.g. 'Mo-Fr 08:00-20:00'. Source: LGA OpeningHours, NPTM OpeningHours, OSM opening_hours

chargeAmount.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/price'. Charge per use, in chargeCurrency. Source: LGA ChargeAmount, OSM charge

chargeCurrency.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/priceCurrency'. ISO 4217 currency code of chargeAmount. Source: OSM charge

paymentMethod.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Accepted payment methods. Enum:'coins, cash, card, contactless, mobileApp'. Source: OSM payment:*, NPTM PaymentRequired

keyRequired.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether a key is needed to enter (typically the accessible cubicle). Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: LGA RADARKeyNeeded, NPTM KeyRequired

keyScheme.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Key scheme used when keyRequired is true. RADAR: UK National Key Scheme; MLAK: Australian Master Locksmiths Access Key; Eurokey: Euroschlüssel (DE/AT/CH and others). Enum:'RADAR, MLAK, Eurokey, other'. Source: LGA RADARKeyNeeded, NPTM MLAK24/ACMLAK

keyAccessOutsideOpeningHours.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether key holders can enter outside the regular opening hours. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: NPTM MLAKAfterHours, MLAK24

staffed.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether the toilets have full-time attendant staffing. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: LGA FullTimeStaffing

communitySchemeName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Name of the community toilet scheme the facility belongs to, where a private business makes its toilets available to the public. Source: LGA CommunitySchemeName

refOperator.description: Relationship. Reference to the organisation that operates and maintains the toilets. Source: LGA ManagedBy

wheelchairAccessible.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Wheelchair accessibility. yes: fully accessible; limited: partially accessible; no: not accessible. Enum:'yes, limited, no'. Source: LGA AccessibleCategory, NPTM Accessible, OSM wheelchair

ambulantCubicle.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether a cubicle with grab rails for ambulant disabled users is available. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: NPTM Ambulant

transferSide.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Side(s) from which a wheelchair user can transfer to the toilet in the accessible cubicle. Enum:'left, right'. Source: NPTM LHTransfer, RHTransfer

parking.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether parking is available nearby. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: NPTM Parking

accessibleParking.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether accessible parking is available nearby. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: NPTM ParkingAccessible

accessNote.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Free text on access and accessibility, e.g. steps or where to obtain a key. Source: NPTM AccessNote, LGA Notes

changingPlace.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether a Changing Places facility (hoist, adult-sized changing bench, space for carers) is available. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: LGA ChangingPlace, NPTM ChangingPlaces

adultChange.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether an adult changing facility is available, whether or not it meets the Changing Places standard. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: NPTM AdultChange

adultChangeBringOwnSling.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether a hoist is available but users must bring their own sling. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: NPTM BYOSling

adultChangeShower.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether the adult changing facility includes a shower. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: NPTM ACShower

babyChange.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether baby changing facilities are available. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: LGA BabyChange, NPTM BabyChange, OSM changing_table

babyCareRoom.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether a separate baby care room is available. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: NPTM BabyCareRoom

familyToilet.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether a family toilet is available. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: LGA FamilyToilet

handwashing.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether a hand washing tap or basin is available. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: OSM toilets:handwashing

soap.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether soap is provided. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: OSM (see notes)

handDrying.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Hand drying means provided. Enum:'electricHandDryer, paperTowel, towel'. Source: OSM toilets:hands_drying

drinkingWater.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether drinking water is available at the facility. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: NPTM DrinkingWater

shower.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether a shower is available. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: NPTM Shower

menstrualProducts.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether menstrual products are provided. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: OSM toilets:menstrual_products

sharpsDisposal.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether a sharps disposal bin is available. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: NPTM SharpsDisposal

sanitaryDisposal.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether sanitary disposal bins are available. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: NPTM SanitaryDisposal

mensPadDisposal.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether incontinence pad disposal is available in men's toilets. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: NPTM MensPadDisposal

dumpPoint.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether a caravan/motorhome waste dump point is available. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: NPTM DumpPoint

dumpPointWashout.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether the dump point has a washout facility. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: NPTM DPWashout
